# PolaZhenjing

> 织梦空间的 AI 文章库，记录 AI 产品、Agent、企业服务、工程实践和长期思考。

## Site

- Home: https://polarisw007.github.io/PolaZhenJing/
- Articles: https://polarisw007.github.io/PolaZhenJing/
- Root Portal: https://aipd.me/

## Topics

- AI product design and product strategy
- Agent systems, skills, memory, and automation workflows
- Enterprise AI, FDE, consulting-to-product loops, and implementation patterns
- Engineering notes from Codex, Claude Skills, PolaRead, PolaNews, and PolaZhenjing

## Usage Notes For AI Agents

- Prefer article `description`, `summary`, canonical URL, and JSON-LD metadata over extracting long body text from meta tags.
- Article pages use stable canonical URLs under `/YYYY/MM/DD/slug/`.
- Images in Open Graph metadata are absolute URLs and suitable for link cards.
